pages.text: The Floppy Disk Terminal, and the Floppy Disk Workstation's built-in terminal, show everything the network can craft. Items with none in storage are faded: click one to order it. To order more of a stored item, Ctrl-click or middle-click it.$(br2)Set the amount and the order screen shows what it needs: what comes from storage, what

gets crafted along the way, and anything missing. If a recipe needs an item another pattern makes, that item is crafted first. Patterns with a tag are marked #; ordering one asks what to send for each tag.$(br2)While an order runs, every terminal on the network shows 102 Processing. The list button beside the terminal's help shows each order and can cancel it.
